question: The graph shows the variation of charge $Q$ versus potential difference $V$ for two capacitors $C_1$ and $C_2$. The two capacitors have the same plate separation but the plate area of $C_2$ is double that of $C_1$. Analyze the graph to identify which line (A or B) corresponds to $C_1$ and justify why.

options.A: Line A corresponds to $C_1$ because it has a steeper slope.
options.B: Line B corresponds to $C_1$ because it has a smaller slope.
options.C: Line A corresponds to $C_1$ because slope represents $1/C$.
options.D: Line A corresponds to $C_2$ because capacitance is directly proportional to slope.
